THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land depicted in below name and extent in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/578 dated 25.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village called Olaithoduvai in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/60, of Ollaithoduvai in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follow:
01. Lot A – Olaithoduvaikaani – Extent: 0.7666 Hectare North: Periyakarisal Grama Niladhari Division and Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known); East: Olaithoduvai-

kaani (claimant not known), Periyakarisal Grama Niladhari Division and Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known); South: Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known); West: Olaithoduvaikaani (claimant not known) and Periyakarisal Grama Niladhari Division.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/11/2023/RE/173-A.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.7th February, 2024.
